# Facebook Video Search Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-video-search-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-video-search-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.309**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Add keywords and extract all associated Facebook reels and videos. Get video data like video URL, video title, description, video owner profile and URL, date posted, views, duration, label, and much more. Export scraped data, schedule scraper via API, integrate with other tools or AI workflows.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Result $0.005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-video-search-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-video-search-scraper@0.0.309#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `searchTerm` | string |  |  | Search query — The scraper will extract videos data found by this keyword |
| `startUrls` | array |  |  | Facebook Video Search URLs — Facebook Video Search URL. Add one by one using Add+ or a whole prepared list using Text file button. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | ✍️ Number of videos — Select the number of videos you want to scrape. |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facebookUrl` | string \| null | URL of the Facebook search that was scraped. |
| `inputUrl` | string \| null | Input URL used to scrape the video search. |
| `facebookId` | string \| null | Facebook ID associated with the search context. |
| `videoUrl` | string \| null | Direct URL to the Facebook video. |
| `label` | string \| null | Accessibility label for the video. |
| `title` | string \| null | Title of the video. |
| `thumbnail_image` | object \| null | Thumbnail image of the video. |
| `video` | object \| null | Video metadata object. |
| `video_owner_profile` | object \| null | Profile information of the video owner. |
| `video_duration_text` | string \| null | Human-readable duration of the video (e.g. '2:05'). |
| `video_broadcast_status` | string \| null | Broadcast status of the video (e.g. VOD, LIVE). |
| `relative_time_string` | string \| null | Human-readable relative time since the video was posted. |
| `save_description` | string \| null | Description text shown in the save action. |
| `pageAdLibrary` | object \| null | Ad Library information for the video owner page. |
| `url` | string \| null | URL that was scraped (present on error items). |
| `error` | string \| null | Error message if scraping this URL failed. |
| `errorDescription` | string \| null | Detailed error description if scraping this URL failed. |
